servinfo.title: ISG Drive Belt Removal and Installation

attention2.ptxt: When removing and installing ISG drive belt, repulsive power of auto tensioner may cause a finger injury.
Handle auto tensioner carefully during service for ISG drive belt.

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when compressing the ISG drive belt tensioner can cause damage to the tensioner.

item.ptxt: Compress the tensioner very slowly using special tool.
Do not apply a force of more than 150 N·m (15.3 kgf-m, 111.0 lbf-ft) when compressing the tensioner.
Do not apply more force when the tensioner stops at full stroke.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove right front fender lining.
For A/C model, remove A/C compressor drive belt.
Fitting special tool to hexagonal section (2), turn ISG drive belt auto tensioner (1) clockwise as shown to compress the tensioner.
Fitting special tool to hexagonal section (2), turn ISG drive belt auto tensioner (1) clockwise as shown to compress the tensioner.
Put ISG drive belt (3) on crankshaft pulley, water pump pulley and ISG pulley fitting belt ribs to pulley grooves correctly.
Remove special tool slowly to give tension to the belt.
Turn crankshaft clockwise 720° and check that all of belt ribs are fitted into all of pulley grooves.
Start engine for 2 to 3 seconds to stabilize the belt tension.
Stop engine and check the state of the belt.
For A/C model, install A/C compressor drive belt.
